::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 81,704 people lived in County Cavan, up 7.3% on 2016. It had the 20th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 34% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Cavan was €1,095, the 21st highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Cavan

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Cavan was €26,471, the 20th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Cavan was €260,200, the 20th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 4.3 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Cavan, the 18th highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 25% of households in County Cavan rented their home, the 11th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 19% of people living in County Cavan were born outside Ireland, the 8th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 36% of people aged 3 and over in County Cavan said they could speak Irish, the second lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 25% of people at work in County Cavan worked from home for at least part of the week, the third lowest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 76% of people travelling to work in County Cavan went by car, the 13th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Cavan live more than 4.1 km by road from a GP, the 4th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Cavan live more than 20.8 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 14th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 10.3% of County Cavan in 2021, the 12th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
